description: This file defines the S3Parser class, a custom parser for handling specific Amazon S3 protocol responses, including error parsing and result mutation mechanisms. It extends the AbstractParser class and is part of the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: Aws\S3\Parser\S3Parser
classes.description: A custom parser designed to handle specific Amazon S3 response parsing scenarios, including error detection in 200 responses, and various result mutator management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the parser with protocol parser, error parser, API service, and exception class.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to parse the S3 response, handling errors and invoking the protocol parser.

methods.name: parse200Error
methods.description: Checks if a 200 response contains an embedded error and throws an exception if so.

methods.name: shouldBeConsidered200Error
methods.description: Determines whether a command's output shape expects a standard 200 error response based on its members.

methods.name: isFirstRootElementError
methods.description: Checks if the beginning of the response body indicates an Error XML element.

methods.name: executeS3ResultMutators
methods.description: Applies all configured result mutators to the parsing result.

methods.name: addS3ResultMutator
methods.description: Adds a new mutator function to the list of result mutators.

methods.name: getS3ResultMutators
methods.description: Returns the list of current result mutators.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing of a member from a stream to the protocol parser.
